name: Mu ai yin
source:
Play as a girl sent to a camp for special education. There, you meet another girl who plans to escape. Will you make it together?

[From [url=https://sakichan.itch.io/maternity-camp]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名被送往营地接受特殊教育的女孩。在那里，你遇到了另一个计划逃跑的女孩。你们会一起做吗？

[来自[url=https://sakichan.itch.io/maternity-camp]Itch.io[/url]]
